summary.headline: GEE Ltd Q1 FY27 revenue rose 30% YoY to INR 103 crores, with EBITDA margin up 204 bps to 7.8%.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 turnover grew 30% YoY to INR 103 crores from INR 79 crores, and EBITDA rose about 77% to INR 8 crores with margin at 7.8% versus 5.7%. PBT rose to INR 5.5 crores from INR 1 crore, and adjusted PAT rose to INR 3.2 crores from INR 1 crore. Management set a North Star of INR 1,000 crores revenue by FY29-30, with 10-13% EBITDA margin ambitions, supported by a NPCIL approval, new SAW wire, SAW flux and flux cored wire lines, and a Thane land monetisation. Management guided that Q1 and Q2 are seasonally weaker due to monsoons.

financial_highlights.change: +77% YoY from INR 4.5 crores (management cited INR 4 crores to INR 4.5 crores base)

segments.name: Electrodes (stick)
segments.commentary: Management said electrode capacity is partly unutilised and sales jumped this quarter; no electrode capacity expansion planned for the next three to four years beyond ancillary lines.

segments.name: MIG / continuous wire
segments.commentary: Wire capacity is described as fully utilised; expansion is planned this year, with the capacity moving from 59,000 MT to 71,000 MT per annum (12,000 MT addition).

segments.name: Niche / special products
segments.commentary: Niche products are around 27% to 30% of revenue; a BHEL Trichy order for P91 steel was received the day before the call.

segments.name: SAW wire and SAW flux
segments.commentary: Commercial production started in Q1 FY27 per management; capacity not included in the 71,000 MT figure.

segments.name: Flux cored wire
segments.commentary: Line of around 300 MT set up, planned to reach 1,000 MT by FY29; first line production expected by end-September or early October; 1,000 MT is said to yield more than INR 150 crores turnover.

guidance_outlook: Revenue North Star of INR 1,000 crores by FY29-30 (organic), then INR 2,000 crores via inorganic growth.
EBITDA margin roadmap: 8% to 9% near term, then 10-11% and 12-13% sustainably; management said it is trying to reach 10% this year.
Peak revenue from 71,000 MT capacity estimated at about INR 850 crores; balance expected from SAW and flux cored lines.
FY27 capex estimated at INR 5-10 crores; INR 30-40 crores total capex over three to four years.
No incremental working capital limits planned for the next year; working capital limit about INR 100 crores with headroom.
Nuclear expected to be at least 10% of business in coming years; shipbuilding (commercial) 3-5% of revenue.
Thane land JD monetisation expected to yield about INR 400 crores over five years via area-sharing; Thane plant shifting targeted by end-September.
capex_capacity: Current capacity 59,000 MT per annum rising to 71,000 MT with 12,000 MT wire addition; MIG wire capacity almost exhausted.

Capex: about INR 400 crores of asset base today, going to INR 500-550 crores this year, with INR 30-40 crores further capex over three to four years to reach INR 1,000 crores (includes Thane plant shift and SAW/flux cored lines).
SAW wire and SAW flux line: one line set up, commercial production started this quarter; capacity not disclosed.
Flux cored wire: one line set up, 300 MT currently, target 1,000 MT by FY29.
Electrode capacity expansion not before 90-95% utilisation of the wire capacity, beyond FY30.
demand_pricing: Management said the industry is about INR 12,000-13,000 crores in size, growing 6-7% CAGR, while GEE targets 20% CAGR and 10-12% market share from about 6% today.

Export orders received from Vietnam, Saudi Arabia, Russia (distributor pursuing NAKS approval), Bahrain, Muscat and Dubai; German rail approval via TUV in progress; trade agreement expected to give 0% duty from next year.
Competition in exports cited as China and some Indian manufacturers; stainless steel cited as the product where India is competitive versus China due to raw material (wire rod) pricing.

NPCIL: GEE is one of three certified vendors with Ador and D&H Secheron; L&T, ISGEC, BHEL and NPCIL have inspected the plant; management expects about 7-8 potential vendors and has orders from 3-4 major players.
Management said consistent per-product margin differences exist but did not quantify niche vs commodity margin; it will provide an average chart next time.

qa_highlights.question: Who are the other NPCIL-empanelled partners and what bids are pending?
qa_highlights.answer: Management named D&H Secheron and Ador as the other certified players; L&T, ISGEC, BHEL and NPCIL have inspected the plant, with MEIL Hyderabad expected to inquire.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 30% growth and 10-11% EBITDA margin achievable this year?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is confident in the INR 1,000 crore target but 'not 100%' on margins, trying to reach 10% this year.

qa_highlights.question: Can electrode and wire capacity be interchanged, and what is the export opportunity?
qa_highlights.answer: Capacities are independent; electrodes have spare capacity, MIG wire is full. Export orders received from Vietnam, Saudi, Russia, and Middle East markets.

qa_highlights.question: How does the INR 30-40 crore capex map to the 20,000 MT capacity and the INR 1,000 crore revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management clarified 12,000 MT wire addition needs far less than INR 30-40 crores; the INR 30-40 crore figure includes Thane shift, SAW and flux cored lines. Peak revenue from 71,000 MT is about INR 850 crores; SAW and flux cored lines bridge to INR 1,000 crores, with 1,000 MT flux cored yielding more than INR 150 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Q1 revenue dip seasonal?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said monsoons in Q1 and Q2 delay construction work; Q4 is always higher and work spills into the next quarter.

qa_highlights.question: What is the debt position and working capital need?
qa_highlights.answer: No term loan on books; only a working capital limit of about INR 100 crores with headroom; no further debt planned, funded by internal accruals and Thane land cash flows.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the promoter share pledged?
qa_highlights.answer: Pledge relates to promoter personal loans of INR 40 crores used for promoter settlement; management expects release over three to four years.

risks_watch: Execution on the INR 1,000 crore North Star by FY29-30 after flat revenue in the prior 2-3 years, with management stating it is confident but 'not 100%' on the 10% EBITDA margin target this year.

Timing and ramp of SAW wire, SAW flux and flux cored wire lines: commercial production of the first flux cored line expected by end-September or early October, and 1,000 MT flux cored capacity targeted by FY29; capacity for SAW lines not disclosed.

NPCIL vendor status and conversion of inspections and the expected MEIL Hyderabad inquiry into orders; nuclear is expected to be at least 10% of business in coming years but no current percentage given.
Thane land JD monetisation (about INR 400 crores over five years via area-sharing) and completion of the Thane plant shift by end-September; cash flow timing depends on developer sales.

Working capital limit of about INR 100 crores with headroom; no incremental limits planned for a year, but capex inconsistencies (INR 30-40 crores vs INR 5-10 crores in FY27) were clarified only under questioning.
Promoter share pledge tied to INR 40 crores of promoter personal loans for promoter settlement, with release expected over three to four years.
Seasonality: Q1 and Q2 weaker due to monsoons; management declined to quantify niche vs commodity margin, promising an average chart next time.
key_quotes: So, these EBITDA margins, are we planning to take it to 10%, 11% this financial year?
See, that we are not 100% but of course, we are trying as we have already explained in our slide also.
No, we are expecting cash flows to start accruing.
No, we're not looking at taking further debt, considering the fact that there's a huge cash flow accrual also coming in to the company.
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on the long-term targets (INR 1,000 crores revenue, 20% CAGR, 10-13% margins), but cautious on near-term margins, saying it is 'not 100%' sure of 10% this year. Several answers on capex, capacity and SAW/flux cored lines were inconsistent and needed clarification from the CFO and JMD during Q&A.

growth.why: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 30% YoY to INR 103 crore and wire is fully utilised, with 12,000 MT wire expansion planned this year and a North Star of INR 1,000 crore by FY29-30, but no explicit next-year revenue growth % was guided and Q1-Q2 are seasonally weak.
